title: Kagamine Rin — First Thunder〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I get the feeling that your dad is still just as kind as he was back then.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is she really gonna tell her dad how she feels...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Talking like this isn't going to solve anything. I'm going to...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
S-So...
KAITO wants to go see how Mafuyu's doing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What's wrong with that?
We might have a problem on our hands here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Which is why I need to go.
What if this is a repeat of when she ran away from home?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I get how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But she might not be feeling well...
You, uhh... You might scare her...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Again, what's wrong with that?
Getting her to move forward is our job.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, let me take care of this situation.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mafuyu... She probably wants to move forward, but doesn't know how.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want to be there for her this time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You think you can handle this?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If no progress has been made by the time her dad visits next, then I'll be going over.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I just didn't want him getting in the way of Mafuyu trying to sort out her feelings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, then, would it be bad for me to go see her...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I don't think so.
Unlike KAITO, you're actually willing to listen to what she has to say.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right now, I think Mafuyu needs someone by her side who'll understand what she's going through.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, then... I think I'll go see her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, considering what I said to KAITO, I wouldn't mind going with you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Rin? Len...?
What brings you two here?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Uhh... Nothing in particular...
We just wanted to talk...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A thunderstorm just happened to roll by the other day, which scared Rin a little.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Every time the sky flashed, it was followed by a deafening boom that made the ground shake.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah... If they scared you that much, Rin, I'm glad I wasn't there...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Huh? Oh, right... Sorry...
You were just a little surprised, right?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Still, if it was that big a thunderstorm, then I don't think you need to feel so embarrassed...>
